_comment: Verified game-context knowledge base. Every entry must cite a publisher-controlled source (Ubisoft Mobile support, the official Invincible GTG social accounts, or the official store listing). Do not add entries sourced only from creator videos: those describe one player's run, not the game's rules. Watch pages match entities by alias against a video's real title, description, and creator excerpt.

entities.name: Boss Raid
entities.summary: A limited-time Alliance mode where members work together to battle a powerful boss. Each attack reduces the boss's shared health and advances progress toward rewards.

entities.name: Hero Boot Camp
entities.summary: A limited-time Hero Boot Camp event featuring a shop stocked with XP and upgrade resources for powering up a roster.

source.title: Hero Bootcamp is back with a shop full of upgrades

entities.name: GDA Case Files
entities.summary: A story event that reopens GDA case files on specific characters. While it runs, the featured heroes have a higher chance of appearing in the recruitment shop, so the event doubles as a targeted recruitment window.

source.title: GDA Case Files event is now active

entities.name: Trick or Treat
entities.summary: The Halloween event: gather as many pumpkins as you can and trade them in for a variety of rewards before the window closes.

source.publisher: Invincible: Guarding the Globe official App Store listing
source.title: Events: Trick or Treat

entities.name: Cursed Protector
entities.summary: An Astounding Wolf-Man event: Wolf-Man tears through evil while fighting to master the savage beast within. It runs alongside Wolf-Man's release window, so most coverage of it doubles as hero evaluation.

source.publisher: Invincible: Guarding the Globe official App Store listing
source.title: Events: Cursed Protector

entities.name: Cecil's Nightmares
entities.summary: A challenge mode built from time-restricted simulations, each with specific challenges. Runs can be replayed and are ranked on a leaderboard per simulation.

entities.name: Lock & Reload
entities.summary: A recruitment event with a twist on the usual shop refresh: find powerful heroes, lock the ones you want to keep, and let everything you did not lock refresh after each purchase.

entities.name: Black Market
entities.summary: A limited-time shop event offering elite and rare heroes, XP, Totems, and other items.

entities.name: Art's Outlet
entities.summary: A limited-time equipment-shop event run by Art Rosenbaum, featuring gear for players to obtain.

source.title: Art Rosenbaum got inspired and the equipment shop will never be the same

entities.name: Faction Recruitment
entities.summary: A limited-time recruitment section that opens up one faction's roster, such as Earth's Defenders, so you can pull heroes from that faction while the window is open.

source.title: Faction Recruitment is open for a limited time

entities.name: Artifacts
entities.summary: Unique gear pieces that add stat bonuses or passive effects on top of a hero's own kit. Every artifact has a rarity level and can be upgraded further to strengthen its benefit.

source.publisher: Invincible: Guarding the Globe official App Store listing
source.title: Artifacts: unique gear with passive effects

entities.name: Cecil's Recruitment Department
entities.summary: The shop where new heroes are recruited. The game describes its stores as transparent alternatives to lootboxes rather than random pulls.

source.publisher: Invincible: Guarding the Globe official App Store listing
source.title: Shops, not lootboxes: Cecil's Recruitment Department

entities.name: Patch notes
entities.summary: Ubisoft publishes per-version patch notes for the game through its mobile support site, covering new characters, GDA Case Files, campaign chapters, and balance changes.
